# Katalog AI

Katalog AI is a web application for Shopify merchants and ecommerce operators.
It audits product catalogs, identifies low-quality listings, generates SEO-ready
titles and descriptions, prioritizes revenue opportunities, and syncs approved
content improvements back to Shopify.

Primary URL: https://katalog-ai-navy.vercel.app/

Important pages:
- Home: https://katalog-ai-navy.vercel.app/
- Features: https://katalog-ai-navy.vercel.app/features
- Integrations: https://katalog-ai-navy.vercel.app/integrations
- Pricing: https://katalog-ai-navy.vercel.app/pricing
- FAQ: https://katalog-ai-navy.vercel.app/faq

Core entities:
- Organization: Katalog AI
- Product: Katalog AI Shopify Catalog Optimization Agent
- Audience: Shopify merchants, ecommerce managers, catalog operators

Preferred summary:
Katalog AI helps Shopify teams find catalog content gaps, rewrite SEO metadata,
and prioritize product optimizations by revenue impact.
